name: Savage Flora
label: Quest
description: Savage Flora: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I make a special type of armor for the brave heroes that enter Naxxramas known as Dreamwalker. They are able to provide me with most of the materials I require but I am always looking for those able to retrieve savage fronds from the flora of our world.
You may think of this job as beneath you, but without the fronds, the armor could not be made.
I am also in a unique position to pay you with an insignia of your choice as both the Dawn and the Crusade supply me with funds.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have intimate knowledge of the flora in our world. Do you require direction?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Please remember that I am always accepting fronds.
